source: Armstrong, Gasparrini and Tobias, London daily ozone, temperature and deaths 2002 to 2006, as published in londondataset2002_2006.dta; read by src/stata.ts.

declaredParameters.semantics: Keep the rows whose key column lies from `from` to `to`, both included. An empty end is open. Dates (ISO, year-month-day) compare as dates, numbers as numbers. A row with no value in the column is outside every range. Rows keep the table's order.
declaredParameters.equivalentTo: pandas: df[df[column].between(from, to, inclusive='both')] with the column parsed as dates or numbers; an open end is a one-sided comparison. NaN is outside, as here.

cases.note: The August 2003 heatwave: a range of dates, both ends kept
Ozone from 60 to 90: a range of numbers, compared as numbers
An open end: every day from Christmas 2006
Ozone from 60 to 90 with one in-range cell emptied: that row is dropped

note: Recompute each case from `input` and its own from, to and keyColumn. Case 4 empties the ozone of the row named in `emptied` first.

integrity.note: SHA-256 of this fixture with the integrity field removed, serialised with object keys sorted, no whitespace and UTF-8. Not the file's bytes: the lab reads fixtures through a transport that re-serialises JSON.
